crm_notes: Inbound SMB lead — founder-run shop (Colette, CEO). Primary pain: product discovery on site and heavy manual Q&A emails. They run Shopify + custom storefront, ~12k SKUs (mostly apparel + accessories). Wants a hosted, low-friction API: quick onboarding, predictable token cost, and good default prompts for product Q&A. Self-serve signup done 2/10; played with sandbox and hit rate limits during a small flash sale test — reported "spikes during promos". SE call confirmed two parallel flows: 1) synchronous product Q&A widget (target p95 < 800ms; lower is ideal), 2) asynchronous nightly catalog enrichment to add attributes/tags + embeddings. Very cost sensitive — asked for guidance on batching, prefix caching and recommended model/quantization for catalog jobs. Security: not enterprise but asked for audit logs and retention controls (legal wants 6mo retention policy). Quote from Colette on call: "We need answers on product pages that don't sound like a robot — tone + attributes matter." Competitor checks: they trialed OpenAI and a smaller vendor; found cost unpredictable under burst. Current blockers: internal budget cycle in late Feb, want a simple POC to demonstrate SLA and unit economics. Action items: share two prompt templates (product Q&A & short product summary), link to hosted_api quickstart, sample cost calc for 10k monthly Q&A sessions and a burst scenario (10k reqs/hour for 2 hours).
